notes:
The launcher now tells the Nova admins when something goes wrong in your game, so problems that hit several players can be found and fixed faster.

While the launcher is open, a small checker reads the newest lines of your game and launcher logs every 10 seconds and sends only the errors. After each game it also sends a short health report. It runs at low priority, never reads a whole log again, and holds off on its bigger check while your game is running.

Before anything leaves your PC, your login token is removed, your IP address is partly hidden, and your PC's name is replaced by a code. To stop sending, go to Settings > Diagnostics and turn off "Share problems with the Nova admins". The report about your own PC is still kept on your PC.

This release also includes everything from 1.9.3 and the loading-screen fix from 1.9.2. These have been built and tested, but not yet played through a full match. If a match misbehaves, send the log from the Logs tab.
